seed_aggregation.paired_uncertainty: For the across-seed mean MIL probability per DEV_VAL customer versus the frozen baseline probability, use 2000 paired customer bootstrap resamples with seed 2402 and percentile 95% intervals

all_required: Mean ROC-AUC delta versus frozen FULL_48 HGB is at least +0.010
Mean average-precision delta versus frozen FULL_48 HGB is at least +0.020
At least 4 of 5 seeds have positive deltas for both primary metrics
Paired 95% bootstrap intervals for the seed-ensemble deltas exclude zero for both primary metrics

discrimination_all_required: Mean ROC-AUC is no more than 0.010 below frozen FULL_48 HGB
Mean average precision is no more than 0.020 below frozen FULL_48 HGB
At least 4 of 5 seeds meet both non-inferiority margins
distinct_result_all_required: Attention concentration is reproducible across seeds under the pre-registered concentration measures
Top-attention removal reduces customer prediction more than matched random removal with a paired 95% interval excluding zero
Top-window overlap or rank stability exceeds its matched random expectation
outcome_B_comparable_plus_distinct_weak_.interpretation: Competitive customer discrimination plus reproducible model-relevance structure learned without instance-level fraud labels

outcome_C_weak.definition: No pooling variant satisfies Outcome A or B, or the attention relevance pattern is no more stable/informative than matched random controls
outcome_C_weak.materially_worse_flag: Mean ROC-AUC more than 0.020 below baseline or mean average precision more than 0.040 below baseline

candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.form: Weakly supervised MIL improved customer-level AP by X over the frozen conventional baseline.
candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.required: Outcome A, exact observed delta, five-seed reproducibility, and paired customer-bootstrap uncertainty

candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.form: A bag-level model trained without temporal fraud labels achieved customer-level ROC-AUC X and AP Y.
candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.required: Completed fixed Stage 24B protocol, full seed distribution, and explicit comparison with the frozen baseline

candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.form: X% of model relevance was concentrated in Y% of customer windows.
candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.required: Pre-registered top-k mass and entropy estimates with customer-level intervals, class-wise reporting, and cross-seed stability

candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.form: Removing the top Y% model-relevant windows reduced customer confidence by X versus Z under random removal.
candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.required: Matched top/random/bottom removal, repeated random controls, paired customer-level uncertainty, and consistent direction across at least 4 of 5 seeds

candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.form: Instance relevance remained stable across five independent seeds.
candidate_anchor_statements_and_required.required: Pairwise top-set Jaccard and within-bag rank correlation materially above matched random expectations across seed pairs
